title: Beef stuffed tomatoes
summary: Beef stuffed tomatoes is a mediterranean dinner built around lean beef mince 5% fat and cherry tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Beef stuffed tomatoes into even pieces and toss cherry tomatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of cherry tomatoes while you season lean beef mince 5% fat. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle lean beef mince 5% fat and basmati rice among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Beef stuffed tomatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Beef stuffed tomatoes into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
